newsitem.title: USA: Durham County, N.C., approves $350 million budget.
newsitem.headline: Durham County, N.C., approves $350 million budget.

text.p: North Carolina's Durham County Commission unanimously approved a $350 million budget that leaves property tax rates unchanged, the News & Observer said.

Durham County's tax rate remains 95.97 cents per $100 of appraised value, still one of the state's highest rates. County Manager David Thompson said the county's fund balance was expected to top $40 million in fiscal 1998, which may enable the county to cut the tax rates next year.
The budget raises the solid waste management fee, which covers trash dumps outside the city limits, to $42.50 from $35.
It allocates $56.1 million for schools, an increase of $1.88 million over this year, and provides $2.1 million of raises for county employees.
